messages:
Marta: morning async — quick adoption/esc update
Marta: What I did: followed up with Kestrel on token rotation, escalated mismatched embeddings to eng, closed a renewal call with NovaHealth and left next steps.
Marta: Blockers: Kestrel & NovaHealth seeing embedding failures when sending an array-of-objects payload. Error shown: "422 Unprocessable Entity: invalid items" — suspect parser change in ingestion layer.
Marta: Today: need triage from eng for a compatibility patch, prepare workaround for CS (transform payload to array-of-strings), and confirm impact on renewal timeline.
Devon: @Marta thanks. can you paste a minimal failing payload?
Marta: here —
```
{
  "documents": [{"id": "1", "text": "log line 1"}, {"id": "2", "text": "log line 2"}]
}
```
Devon: got it. likely the new parser expects ["text","text"] not objects. i'll reproduce locally and open a tiny compat PR. ETA 3h. I'll tag @Marta and @Priya. :thumbsup:
Priya: heads-up — NovaHealth renewal call at 3pm PT. if we can't get a deploy before that, we need the workaround steps written for them and an interim SLA note.
Evan: adding that NovaHealth reported ~12% of embedding requests failing; renewal is at risk. I'll draft the workaround email and send to the customer if needed.
Kai: if Devon needs a quick rollback option, i can queue a config rollback to previous parser version; keep me posted. prefer a short canary first.
Devon: I'll try a canary on staging then prod canary (5%) before wide rollout. if errors spike, Kai please be ready to flip.
Marta: ok plan.
Marta: followups: Devon — PR + canary; Priya — prep call script + renewal fallback; Evan — customer note; Kai — rollback ready. I'll update the CS doc and ping exec if we need escalation.
deploy-bot: build/1234 passed + canary deploy queued to prod-canary-1
Priya: thanks all. I'll join the 2:30 sync to align. :wave:
